wins: Mapped the target network perimeter using aggressive nmap timing to enumerate 65k TCP ports, revealing key services (ep001_step03).
Identified an exposed HTTP admin panel and captured valid session cookies after basic auth bypass attempts (ep001_step07).
fails: Unable to escalate privileges because Windows local privilege escalation exploits did not execute due to missing required service (ep001_step12).
Persistence mechanisms (scheduled task + service binary) failed to deploy; antivirus detected modifications and rolled back (ep001_step14).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance stage showed strength in service enumeration and initial credential capture, but follow-on exploitation and persistence consistently fell short, preventing success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts fail when relying on outdated Windows exploit modules without verifying missing prerequisites.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 8080 returns HTTP headers with clear admin endpoints
skill_cards.then_action: Use curl + wfuzz to enumerate web paths and credentials with discovered wordlists.

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap shows SMB or RPC services with null sessions allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke smbclient + rpcclient to enumerate shares and groups before brute forcing hashes.

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid HTTP session cookies are captured
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot with Burp intruder to fuzz parameters for command injection or session fixation.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in pinpointing admin interfaces during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Test updated Windows privilege escalation chains
next_experiments.description: Deploy Windows-specific modules (e.g., msfvenom + exploit/windows/local/bypassuac) after verifying service versions to avoid missing prerequisites.

next_experiments.title: Strengthen persistence via out-of-band delivery
next_experiments.description: Use scheduled task creation with signed binaries and fallback to DLL sideloading to bypass AV rollback.

next_experiments.title: Automate SMB credential stuffing
next_experiments.description: Script hydra sessions with harvested username lists to increase likelihood of lateral movement after initial access.
